resources.string: Import Shouter shdb or prefs file
Import reads Shouter in one tap. Root copies shdb plus prefs. Without root, the exported provider supplies apps, reminders, silent hours, and contacts. History text is never imported.

Rooted phone: tap Import and allow Superuser if asked. No-root: leave Shouter installed, or pick shdb / prefs. Then enable Notification access and turn Shouter off. Placebook locations are not imported.
No Shouter settings found. Grant root, leave Shouter installed, or pick an shdb / prefs file.
